decisive_items: at which time endometriosis was noted
biopsy of inflamed areas demonstrated acute inflammation and foci of endometriosis
response.rationale: Biopsy-proven endometriosis in the inflamed pericecal/ileal tissue, together with the prior history of endometriosis, best explains the clinical picture; the small-bowel obstruction is a secondary complication of the endometriotic mass rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Acute appendicitis was only a presumptive diagnosis; laparoscopy found no appendix and biopsy showed endometriosis, not appendicitis.
Neoplasm was only mentioned in the differential and has no histologic support; biopsy demonstrated endometriosis.
Small-bowel obstruction is a repeat CT finding/complication secondary to the pericecal soft-tissue mass, not the underlying most likely diagnosis.
